title: Page heading of the create-account screen (like Special:CreateAccount).
usernamePublicLearnMore: Username field description (variant), followed by a {{msg|createAccount-learnMore}} link to the username policy.
learnMore: Link to the username policy page after {{msg|createAccount-usernamePublicLearnMore}}.
avoidRealName: Username field description, followed by a help button that opens the username policy.
usernamePolicy: Title of the username policy popover/sheet, and accessible label of the help button that opens it.
thingsToKnow: Username field description (variant). $1 = link with the text {{msg|createAccount-thingsToKnowLink}} that opens the username policy.
usernameIsPublic: Username field description (variant). $1 = link with the text {{msg|createAccount-usernameIsPublicLink}} that opens the username policy.
usernameIsPublicLink: Link text inside {{msg|createAccount-usernameIsPublic}} (an adjective describing the username).
checkingAvailability: Progress label shown while the username availability is being checked.
usernameAvailable: Success message under the username field.
usernameTaken: Error/warning under the username field; may be followed by {{msg|createAccount-tryUsername}}.
tryUsername: Follows {{msg|createAccount-usernameTaken}}. $1 = a suggested available username (rendered as a clickable link or chip).
usernameSuggestion: Help text under the username field. $1 = a generated username (rendered as a clickable link or chip).
generateUsername: Accessible label of the reload button that generates another username suggestion.
generateUsernames: Accessible label of the reload button that generates three new username suggestions.
passwordHelp: Help text under the password field.
emailPasswordInstead: Checkbox label: instead of choosing a password, receive one by email.
confirmPasswordLabel: Label of the password confirmation field.
confirmPasswordPlaceholder: Placeholder of the password confirmation field.
continue: Button that advances to the next field in the multi-step form.
submit: Submit button of the create-account form.
showPassword: Accessible label of the eye button in a password field.
hidePassword: Accessible label of the eye button in a password field while the password is visible.
errorUsernameEmpty: Validation error for an empty username.
errorPasswordEmpty: Validation error for an empty password.
errorPasswordLength: Validation error for a too-short password. $1 = minimum number of characters (8).
errorConfirmEmpty: Validation error for an empty password confirmation.
errorPasswordMismatch: Validation error when the two passwords differ.
errorEmailEmpty: Validation error when an email is required (email-me-a-password option) but empty.
errorEmailInvalid: Validation error for a malformed email address.
warningPasswordWeak: Warning under the password field for a weak password (does not block submission).
policyPrivacy: Username policy bullet. $1 = {{msg|createAccount-policyPrivacyRisks}}, rendered in bold.
policyFullLink: Link to the wiki's username policy page.
hcaptcha: Disclaimer under the create-account button. $1 = link {{msg|createAccount-hcaptchaPrivacy}}, $2 = link {{msg|createAccount-hcaptchaTerms}} (both hCaptcha documents). "hCaptcha" is a product name.
hcaptchaPrivacy: Link text for hCaptcha's privacy policy, inside {{msg|createAccount-hcaptcha}}.
hcaptchaTerms: Link text for hCaptcha's terms of service, inside {{msg|createAccount-hcaptcha}}.
